headline: Compliance is absent at the point of dialling in 6 of 6 dashboards: no consent, DND/NCPR or DLT field on any campaign or batch form; window defaults are 00:00-23:59 (Retell), 09:00-21:00 per agent (Bolna) or none (ElevenLabs); only Exotel shows a Transactional/Promotional call type (notes only).

No dashboard shows a predicted reply gap; turn-taking units differ (Vapi 1.5 s wait, Bolna 500 + 900 ms, ElevenLabs enum, Retell 0 ms added wait with 0.9 interruption, Sarvam and Exotel hidden) and 0 of 6 ship Hindi/Hinglish backchannel or interruption lists. The Hinglish turn-taking beat stays unproven.

Displayed latency and cost headlines are component sums that leave out telephony and the turn wait (Vapi ~1,530 ms = 410+690+430 against a measured 2,319 ms demo p50; Retell USD 0.134 = 0.055+0.015+0.064); per-option metrics exist only at Vapi and ElevenLabs, price-only at Retell, none at Bolna, Sarvam, Exotel.

No walkthrough reached a ring on an Indian line; each stopped at a different gate (Vapi US-only inbound numbers, Retell Persona KYC, ElevenLabs import-only with Singapore default, Bolna compliance application + Vobiz KYC that accepts persons, Sarvam rent/BYO unopened, Exotel KYC + GST). W7 is untested on both sides.

0 of 6 offer a Hinglish or code-mixed language option; Sarvam (11 Indic languages, native-script picker, Indic numbers) and Bolna (22 add-language options, per-language chips) lead; Retell has 0 Indian voices and Vapi's picker shows 5 Indian languages against 12 in its API.

Defaults hold lines open or raise spend: Retell burst ON (+USD 0.10/min), 10-min silence hang-up, 1 h max, data kept forever; ElevenLabs all 9 system tools off including End conversation, silence end-call disabled, bursting on; no spend cap seen in any dashboard.

Dashboards write or hide state: Vapi publishes a tool on a menu click and autosaves drafts; Bolna and Sarvam show no unsaved state; Vapi Next and Retell Send are disabled with no reason, while Sarvam's inline Commit version gate and Bolna's Create one link show the fix pattern.
A chat assistant ships in 5 of 6 dashboards (Composer, Conductor, Architect free through October 2026, Genie, Ask Bolna); none was exercised, so chat setup remains parity, not a wedge.

Cross-call memory is now visible in two UIs: Retell reads contact memory by default and saves it at USD 0.005 per run (off); ElevenLabs shows a Memory (Alpha) tab where its API returned 403 a day earlier.

Prior claims change: Bolna's 6 cents includes the platform fee (~INR 5.72 displayed) with a 30 s pulse on all lines; Retell has fixed roles on trial and Asia/Calcutta batch default; ElevenLabs' default LLM is DeepSeek Flash 4.1; Sarvam Business is purchasable; nine vendor-analyst claims were corrected from the pixels.
must_be_changes: ADD A: Price and India-measured latency (p50/p90 with n and date) at every model, voice and transcriber choice, plus an all-in INR per connected minute that includes telephony, pulse and turn wait. Evidence: inline metrics only at Vapi (vapi 51) and ElevenLabs (elevenlabs 61), price-only at Retell (retell 09), none at Bolna, Sarvam, Exotel; headlines exclude telephony and wait (vapi 33, retell 09).

ADD B: Contacts with India-default E.164, DND status and attempt history (memory slot reserved for v2). Evidence: Retell Contacts with a Do Not Call column and contact memory (retell 09, text 42); ElevenLabs users are an ID string; Vapi and Bolna have no contact object; suppression across campaigns needs it.

ADD C: Bounded call and spend defaults: end-call on, silence hang-up on with a bounded value, max duration set, burst opt-in, spend cap per workspace and API key. Evidence: Retell burst ON, 10 min silence, 1 h max (retell 5x-settings, text); ElevenLabs end tool off and silence end-call disabled (elevenlabs 42); Exotel max duration off; no spend cap seen in 6 dashboards.

ADD D: State integrity: no click creates or publishes, an unsaved marker, a reason and fix link beside every disabled primary action, distinct empty/zero/loading/failed states. Evidence: vapi 57 and 80, bolna 21 (text), sarvam 03, vapi 83, retell 24, sarvam 29, retell 43.

PROMOTE: AI disclosure from a VP rule to a must-be on every creation path, templates and copilot output included. Evidence: ElevenLabs default first message has none (elevenlabs 61); Sarvam's is a prompt line (sarvam 01); no dashboard enforces it.

SHARPEN 1 (test call): browser voice and text test with no phone number or KYC, docked beside the editor. Evidence: exotel-02 web call Coming soon; bolna 01 phone-only to verified numbers; sarvam 10, retell 09, elevenlabs 61 browser tests.
SHARPEN 2 (CSV campaign): CSV contract before upload, per-row overrides, row preview with reasons, cross-format dedupe. Evidence: elevenlabs 33 contract; retell 24 recipients preview.

SHARPEN 3 and 4 (window, retries): window derived from call category, never 00:00-23:59 by default; retries by outcome on the campaign form, not a separate workflow. Evidence: retell 25 default; Bolna window per agent (text) and Retry node as the only retry mechanism with campaigns requiring a published workflow (bolna 23, 22).
SHARPEN 15 (versions): explicit publish with a diff and the version shown in the call log. Evidence: sarvam 26 commit gate; exotel-04-rollout version pill; Exotel log version column (notes).

SHARPEN 16 (Indian CLI path): number types, KYC documents, expected time and price stated before any credential is asked. Evidence: gates at vapi 06c, retell 30, elevenlabs 34, bolna 25, sarvam 23, exotel-01.

SHARPEN 17 (Hindi/Hinglish + Indic): an explicit Hinglish (code-mixed) mode and voices filterable by language with counts. Evidence: 0 of 6 have a Hinglish option; retell 10 and bolna 19 lack language filters.

SHARPEN 18 (suppression/DNC): one DNC list honoured on batch, campaign, API and single call, with in-call opt-out capture on by default. Evidence: retell 13 toggle is in-call capture and off; sarvam 33 DND only as an API card.

SHARPEN 13, 19, 20, 11: call log shows business outcome, cost, end-to-end latency and version (retell 41; Vapi raw codes); INR rate table with stated pulse at most 30 s (sarvam 22 shows 60 s; bolna 34 shows 30 s); fixed roles on every plan including trial (retell 6z-roles vs bolna 36-account-Team-Members); post-call judge defaults visible and editable (retell 76).

MOVE 21 (India data residency) out of the self-serve UI floor into architecture and BFSI contract terms: India call path by default, residency in the contract. Evidence: 0 of 6 dashboards expose a data region or residency control; Exotel account region reads Singapore in notes.
next_evidence: 1. Second dashboard pass, no calls and no spend, capturing below the fold from text and never clicking Create-type menus: Bolna New Agent draft Engine/Calling/Intelligence tabs, Vapi Advanced slider values, Sarvam Listening section, Retell call-settings toggles and Agent Handbook disclosure state, ElevenLabs Agent behavior drawer (hinglish_mode) and voice Language filter, Exotel create-agent form and Talk to Agent; re-check Vapi voices (12 vs 22), concurrent simulations (1 vs 2) and ZDR wording.

2. Messy 50-row CSV uploads into draft or paused campaigns where no number is required (Bolna Batches first), with the fail-closed renderer and Delhi 11-series numbers; score out of 50 and rings on N2.
3. Screen-recorded T0 per vendor with owner-approved KYC and numbers: minutes and clicks from sign-up to a ring on our Plivo line, CLI series seen, and each gate's stated time and cost.

4. Stereo Hinglish call battery, Bolna first, on dashboard-created default agents: reply gap p50/p90 with n of 30 or more clean turns, cut-ins at the 2.4 s pause, short replies over the agent, speech during the opening (Bolna toggle off and on), voicemail on Indian operator announcements, silence handling against the captured defaults, and T9c disclosure on default templates.

5. T7 billing audit: 10 calls each at 30, 45 and 90 s per vendor; invoice lines against the displayed headlines (Vapi USD 0.09, Retell USD 0.134, Bolna USD 0.060, Sarvam Rs 3.5) and the pulses (Bolna 30 s, Sarvam 60 s).
6. Five-user human usability sessions on the same tasks (create agent, test, add number, build campaign, find a failed call), since Instinct measured an agent's path, not a buyer's.
